name: MyStreetData USA
tagline: Search US streets and retrieve sourced walkability, SNAP retailer and EV station context.
description: Free, read-only hosted MCP covering 1,334,459 street records in 241 areas across 8 US states. Five tools expose coverage, prefix search, context and comparisons. EPA walkability is block-group context assigned by centroid; SNAP/AFDC counts are state-bounded observations, not live availability. Unknown values remain null. The public repository contains connection metadata, not server source.

install.notes: No account or API key. Limits: 30 calls/minute and 100/day per origin, 1,000/day globally. Native clients only; browser-hosted cross-origin clients are unsupported. Start with mystreetdata_get_coverage. Not nationwide coverage.
